name: DocuSign
whatYouLose: Legal and regulatory assurance across jurisdictions
Identity verification, audit evidence and tamper controls
Enterprise integrations, templates and signer reliability
prompt: Build a basic document approval and signature workflow for low-risk internal agreements. Upload PDF files, place text and signature fields, invite signers by email, issue expiring secure links, capture consent, create a timestamped audit log, lock the final document hash, and provide signed PDF downloads. Use Astro SSR and vanilla JavaScript. Clearly label the product as unsuitable for regulated or high-stakes legal transactions without professional review.
notes: You can reproduce the gesture of signing. You cannot casually reproduce the legal, identity and evidentiary system customers rely on.
